A3_S6_D4: ^Elder: Ah… It feels monumental for me to be alive during one of the Great Floods.
^Elder: Are your preparations to move into the mountains underway?
^Amaya: We’re keeping an eye on the weather. So long as the floods stay on schedule, we still have time.
^Chione: I’ll send you our stock-checks soon! A lot of the herbs we have are still undergoing preservation. But it should be enough for a month or two in the caves.
^Oren: I’ve been looking through our old records. Other than the usual supplies… I think it’d also be worth transporting entertainment items, if we have the time.
^Oren: Cabin fever begins around the second week. Oh! And there were issues regarding the lack of sunlight.
^Chione: Some plants that glow in the dark should help if we create a ‘daylight zone’ in the caves. And it should burn less fuel for lamps and such.
^Amaya: …Once, I ran into a Krakenfolk who was traveling in the night. And when he jumped, thinking I was an attacker — his hair glowed bright, like the plankton that affects the waves.
^Amaya: I’m sure they can’t do it for hours on end, but it may be worth checking if any Krakenfolk are interested in becoming a sort of patrol unit.
^Amaya: Their ability to melt the darkness may prove useful in times like this.
